# Tebra

> Tebra is an integrated EHR, practice management, and revenue cycle platform purpose-built for independent medical practices with AI-powered clinical documentation and patient engagement tools.

Tebra provides an all-in-one solution combining electronic health records, medical billing, patient payments, scheduling, telehealth, and marketing automation. The platform serves independent practices across multiple specialties with ONC-certified EHR technology, HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, and AI-assisted clinical workflows.

## Key Topics

- EHR (Electronic Health Records)
- Practice Management
- Medical Billing & RCM
- Patient Engagement
- AI Note Assist
- Telehealth
- Patient Portal
- Online Scheduling
- HIPAA Compliance
- Independent Practices
- Clinical Documentation
- Patient Payments
- Reputation Management
- eLabs Integration
- Healthcare Platform

## Core Platform

- [Tebra Home](https://www.tebra.com): Tebra homepage: integrated EHR, billing, scheduling, and AI tools
- [EHR Software](https://www.tebra.com/ehr-software): ONC-certified EHR with AI Note Assist for clinical workflows
- [Billing & Revenue Management](https://www.tebra.com/billing-payments): Revenue management platform with claims, eligibility, and collections
- [Patient Experience](https://www.tebra.com/patient-experience): Patient engagement with Care Connect, scheduling, and reviews
- [Marketing & Reputation](https://www.tebra.com/marketing): AI-powered marketing and reputation management for practices

## Clinical & Care Delivery

- [Patient Portal](https://www.tebra.com/ehr-software/patient-portal): Secure patient portal with records, messaging, and payments
- [Telehealth Solutions](https://www.tebra.com/care-delivery/telehealth): HIPAA-compliant telehealth integrated with EHR for virtual care
- [Online Scheduling](https://www.tebra.com/patient-experience/online-scheduling): Online booking system reducing staff time and improving experience
- [eLabs Integration](https://www.tebra.com/care-delivery/electronic-labs): eLabs for secure lab ordering and results tracking integration

## Patient Financial Services

- [Patient Payments](https://www.tebra.com/billing-payments/patient-payments): Patient payment solutions with automated billing and digital options
- [Billing Software for Billing Companies](https://www.tebra.com/billing-payments/for-billing-companies): RCM platform for billing companies with automation and analytics

## Specialty Solutions

- [Family Medicine](https://www.tebra.com/specialties/family-medicine): Tebra platform tailored for family medicine practices
- [Primary Care](https://www.tebra.com/specialties/primary-care): Primary care specialty solution with EHR and billing integration
- [Pediatrics](https://www.tebra.com/specialties/pediatrics): Pediatrics specialty platform with EHR and practice management
- [Mental Health & Psychology](https://www.tebra.com/specialties/psychology): Psychology practice platform with billing and patient acquisition
- [Nurse Practitioners](https://www.tebra.com/specialties/nurse-practitioners): NP-focused EHR with AI charting, telehealth, and practice tools

## Practice Types

- [For Independent Practices](https://www.tebra.com/independent-practices): Integrated platform for independent practices: EHR, billing, growth

## Access & Support

- [Sign In](https://www.tebra.com/sign-in): Login portal for Tebra, Kareo, and PatientPop platform access
- [Help Center](https://helpme.tebra.com): Central help hub for Tebra PM, EHR, billing, and training resources
